settings.name: Allow Self-Loops
settings.description: Allow entrances to loop back to the same map. Might make the topology of the world very confusing.

settings.name: No Entrance Polarity
settings.description:
Some entrances have a polarity, for example dungeon entrances and exits.
Normally, they're shuffled respecting that polarity, so a dungeon entrance will always lead to the inside of a dungeon, never to a dungeon exit. This option disables that.

settings.name: Decoupled Entrances
settings.description:
Makes the entrances decoupled from the exits.
This means that entering and exiting an area does not lead you back to where you came from, but to a different location instead.

settings.name: Boss Entrance Shuffle
settings.description: Shuffle bosses either within their own game or across both

settings.name: Dungeon Entrance Shuffle
settings.description: Shuffle dungeons either within their own game or across both

settings.name: Shuffle Major Dungeons with Dungeons
settings.description: If turned on, the boss-containing dungeons and uninverted Stone Tower Temple will be shuffled among dungeons.

settings.name: Shuffle OoT Minor Dungeons with Dungeons
settings.description: If turned on, Bottom of the Well, Ice Cavern and Gerudo Training Grounds will be shuffled among dungeons.

settings.name: Shuffle Ganon's Castle with Dungeons
settings.description: If turned on, Ganon's Castle will be shuffled among dungeons.

settings.name: Shuffle Ganon's Tower with Dungeons
settings.description: If turned on, Ganon's Tower will be shuffled among dungeons.

settings.name: Shuffle Clock Tower Roof with Dungeons
settings.description:
If turned on, Clock Tower Roof will be shuffled among dungeons.
When paired with another dungeon shuffle, saving is enabled on the Clock Tower Roof, allowing you to leave by warping back to spawn.

settings.name: Shuffle Spider Houses with Dungeons
settings.description: If turned on, the Swamp and Ocean Spider Houses will be shuffled among dungeons.

settings.name: Shuffle Pirates' Fortress with Dungeons
settings.description:
If turned on, the main Pirates' Fortress entrance will be shuffled among dungeons.
This setting is disabled if the other entrances are shuffled among the overworld.

settings.name: Shuffle Beneath The Well with Dungeons
settings.description: If turned on, the entrance in Ikana Canyon and the exit in Ikana Castle Exterior will be shuffled among dungeons.

settings.name: Shuffle Ikana Castle's Interior with Dungeons
settings.description: If turned on, the main entrance leading into Ikana Castle's Interior will be shuffled among dungeons.

settings.name: Shuffle Secret Shrine with Dungeons
settings.description: If turned on, Secret Shrine will be shuffled among dungeons.

settings.name: Grotto Shuffle
settings.description: Shuffle grottos and graves either within their own game or across both

settings.name: Interiors Shuffle
settings.description: Shuffle interiors either within their own game or across both

settings.name: Shuffle Most Interiors
settings.description: Shuffle most interiors with each other.

settings.name: Shuffle Extra Interiors
settings.description:
Shuffle additional, more complex interiors. These include:
- OoT: Link's House, Temple of Time, Windmill, Kak Potion Shop
- MM: Stock Pot Inn, Astral Observatory/Bombers' Hideout, Swamp Tourist Hut, Ikana Spring Cave, Music Box House
- Pirate's Fortress Sewers Exit if Shuffle Pirate Fortress Entrances is enabled

settings.name: Shuffle Telescopes
settings.description: Shuffle Telescopes (Astral Observatory, Kafei Hideout, Pirate Fortress Sewers) among the interiors.

settings.name: Shuffle Mask Shop/Clock Tower Entrances
settings.description: Shuffle the Mask Shop & Clock Tower entrances among the other indoors.

settings.name: Major Regions Shuffle
settings.description:
Shuffle major regions either within their own game or across both. These include:
- Every entrance to Hyrule Field except Market
- The entrance to Gerudo Fortress from Gerudo Valley
- The entrance to Death Mountain from Kakariko
- The entrances to the four main regions in MM
- The entrance to Romani Ranch

settings.name: Shuffle Market Entrance
settings.description: Shuffle the entrance from Hyrule Field to Market among the regions.

settings.name: Shuffle Regional Shortcuts
settings.description:
Shuffles the various shortcuts between regions. These include:
- Lost Woods/Goron City
- Lost Woods/Zora's River
- Zora's Domain/Lake Hylia

settings.name: Overworld Shuffle
settings.description: Shuffle every overworld entrance either within their own game or across both

settings.name: Shuffle Pirates' Fortress Entrances
settings.description:
Shuffle some entrances within Pirates' Fortress, including the main entrance if Overworld ER is enabled.
Shuffle the Sewers exit door if Extra Interiors are enabled.

settings.name: Mixed Pools
settings.description: Allow shuffling multiple pools together.

settings.name: Mixed Pools - Dungeons
settings.description: If turned on, dungeons will be shuffled with other mixed pools.

settings.name: Mixed Pools - Grottos
settings.description: If turned on, grottos will be shuffled with other mixed pools.

settings.name: Mixed Pools - Interiors
settings.description: If turned on, interiors will be shuffled with other mixed pools.

settings.name: Mixed Pools - Regions
settings.description: If turned on, regions will be shuffled with other mixed pools.

settings.name: Mixed Pools - Overworld
settings.description: If turned on, overworld entrances will be shuffled with other mixed pools.

settings.name: Spawn Shuffle
settings.description: Shuffle the starting positions of the player in OoT.

settings.name: Wallmaster Shuffle
settings.description: Enables the ability for Wallmasters to take you to random locations within their own game or across both games, based on other entrance settings

settings.name: Warp Songs and Soaring Spots Shuffle
settings.description: Allows separate shuffling of the warp songs and soaring spots. This setting is disabled if both are selected in "One-Ways Shuffle".

values.name: None
values.description: Warp songs and soaring spots are not shuffled.

values.name: OoT Only
values.description: Shuffles only OoT's warp songs among each other.

values.name: MM Only
values.description: Shuffles only MM's soaring spots among each other.

values.name: Own Game
values.description: Shuffles both warp songs and soaring spots within their own game.

values.name: Full
values.description: Shuffles both warp songs and soaring spots together.

settings.name: One-Ways Shuffle
settings.description: Enables the option of shuffling various one-way entrances.

values.name: Own Game
values.description: One-way entrances are only shuffled among their own game.

values.name: Full
values.description: One-way entrances can be shuffled among both games.

settings.name: Shuffle Standard One-Ways
settings.description: Shuffles the Gerudo Valley to Lake Hylia and Ikana Canyon to Southern Swamp entrances.

settings.name: Shuffle Ikana Castle One-Ways
settings.description: Shuffles the one-way entrances in Ikana Castle among the others. This is the keg-blocked entrance and the block moved by the switch.

settings.name: Shuffle Warp Songs with One-Ways
settings.description: Shuffles the warp songs from OoT among one-way entrances. This setting is disabled if the warp songs are shuffled with "Warp Songs and Soaring Spots Shuffle".
settings.condition: (x: any) => hasOoT(x) && x.erOneWays !== 'none' && x.erWarps !== 'ootOnly' && x.erWarps !== 'full' && x.erWarps !== 'ownGame'

settings.name: Shuffle Soaring Spots with One-Ways
settings.description: Shuffles the soaring spots from MM among one-way entrances. This setting is disabled if the soaring spots are shuffled with "Warp Songs and Soaring Spots Shuffle".
settings.condition: (x: any) => hasMM(x) && x.erOneWays !== 'none' && x.erWarps !== 'mmOnly' && x.erWarps !== 'full' && x.erWarps !== 'ownGame'

settings.name: Shuffle Child Owl Flights
settings.description: Shuffle the two owl flights among one-way entrances.

settings.name: Shuffle Altered Lost Woods Exits
settings.description: Shuffle the Lost Woods exits added by the "Alter Lost Woods Exits" setting among one-way entrances.

settings.name: Shuffle the Water Void Points in MM
settings.description:
Shuffle the Water Void points among one-way entrances. These can be found at:
- Zora Cape
- Great Bay Coast, south of the Pinnacle Rock entrance
- Great Bay Coast, north of the Pinnacle Rock entrance
- Pinnacle Rock

settings.name: Allow One-Ways to take you elsewhere than other one-ways
settings.description:
Makes it so one-ways can take you to any place also shuffled.
This also affects warp songs and soaring spots if they are included in one-ways.
